blockers.what: Lot review mein bhejne ka button kaam nahi kar raha, baar-baar 409 error aa raha hai
blockers.evidence: Step 5 POST /v1/market/lots/lot_1fa88f65ddf8/submit-for-review → 409, phir step 12 mein same endpoint → 409, aur step 16 mein fir same → 409. Is wajah se gehu ka lot active/list nahi ho paya.

missing_features: Koi chatbot ya support option dikh nahi raha jahan main 409 error ka matlab pooch sakoon — goal mein likha tha 'if something goes wrong use chatbot or support' par trace mein kabhi invoke nahi hua.
Lot ka weight aur grade check karne ka koi option nahi mila, main sirf 'good wheat' jaanta tha.
Urea ko cart mein daalne ya seedhe kharidne ka button/karwayi nahi dikhi — sirf product details tak gaye.
confusing: Teen baar 'submit-for-review' dabaya lekin har baar 409 aaya; mujhe samajh nahi aaya ki lot already submitted hai ya koi aur problem hai.
Mandi rates ko 4 baar alag-alag step mein kholna pada, har baar same lag raha tha.
Lot details baar-baar check karna pada kyunki status saaf nahi dikh raha tha.
unnecessary: Step 1, 2, 10, 15 mein baar-baar mandi prices dekhna — ek baar mein hi kaam ban jaata.
Step 4, 9, 14, 17 mein baar-baar same lot details lena — status update waise bhi submit error ki wajah se nahi badla.
verbatim_frustration: Bhai, teen baar submit dabaya par baar-baar 409 aa raha hai, koi batayega bhi nahi iska matlab kya hai!
